title: Translation invariance of f·Hⁿ for a translation-invariant density f
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P, f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] an arbitrary function (no measurability assumed), and y ∈ ℝ^P with f(y + x) = f(x) for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Let ν := H^n.withDensity f, so ν(B) = ∫⁻_B f dH^n for Borel B. Then ν((x ↦ y + x)⁻¹(A)) = ν(A) for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P; that is, ν(A − y) = ν(A).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (y : Euclid P), (∀ x : Euclid P, f (y + x) = f x) → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity f A
